enunciado: Implement SinglyLinkedList with pushFront, pushBack, contains, remove (first occurrence) and reverse (relinking, without creating nodes). Run a sequence of operations showing the list.
objetivos: Handle special cases: empty list and first node
Reverse a list with three references
pistas: To remove, you need the node BEFORE the one being deleted.
If the head is removed, the head becomes its next.
Reverse: previous, current, next; flip one link per iteration.
